methodology.purpose: Track uniquely observed serial-numbered copies in public market data.
rules: Each physical serial number counts only once regardless of how many times it is resold.
A serial number is tied to an exact card identity: product, player, set, parallel and card number.
Observed copies prove that at least that many copies have been opened.
Unobserved copies must not automatically be treated as sealed or unopened.
Live adjusted odds require a separate estimate of how much unopened product remains.
